results.rationale: Consistency: The distant hills, upper-right clearing and aerial composition remain recognizable, but forest foliage throughout has become chunky and patterned, and the foreground grassy bank and tree groups have changed visibly beyond the required channel edit. Instruction: The narrow meandering river becomes a broad bulbous water body connected to the foreground channel. A successful edit would show a cut-off crescent lake alongside a separate main river; neither the separation nor crescent shape is achieved, so most of the defining change is missing.
